description: Required run artefacts for ONE archived run directory (for example
file and reports every missing item as 'MISSING: <path> (reason)', exiting 1.
Inventory only: nothing here changes motion, task definitions, evaluators or
thresholds. Adding a newly required log is a config edit, not a code edit.

phases.success: the run reached the task layer and its own RESULT reports success
phases.failure: the run reached the task layer and did not report success, or it had started but kept no RESULT
phases.startup_failure: the run never reached the task layer (no episode, no decision, no skill jsonl)

items.reason: no parseable RESULT line in task.out: the task's own outcome is unrecorded and runtime/recovery reads task.out
launch capture missing: a run that never reached the task layer must still record why it did not start
no crash/failure detail retained anywhere (checked crash_detail.txt, failure_evidence.json:detail, task.out RESULT detail and launch.out crash markers)
no episode record under sim/episodes/: the policy input/output sequence cannot be replayed offline (contracts/episode.py)
no decision record: which decision was dispatched, on which policy input, is unrecorded
neither task_fsm.jsonl nor demo_runs.jsonl exists: the task FSM's stage history is unrecorded
the run's stage evidence names this skill but its jsonl was not retained
no skill jsonl at all: a run that reached the task layer kept none of its per-skill records
failed run without failure_evidence.json: runtime/recovery's failure record was not retained
a passing run must retain the independent verdict that says it passed
